testcases.title: GEO-69-TC001 - Category brand matrix is displayed with category-scoped data

steps.title: Given an Editor opens a category view
When the matrix loads
Then the Brand Prioritization Matrix is shown with category-scoped data

testcases.title: GEO-69-TC002 - Category brand matrix updates when LLM filter changes

steps.title: Given LLM filters are applied
When the LLM filter is changed
Then the matrix reflects the new LLM filter scope and remains visible

testcases.title: GEO-69-TC003 - Hovering a data point shows brand metrics in tooltip

steps.title: Given the matrix is populated
When a user hovers over a data point
Then brand metrics are accessible on the scatter (SOV, win rate, %)

testcases.title: GEO-69-TC004 - All markets view shows multiple brand data points

steps.title: Given All markets filter (default state)
When the matrix loads
Then multiple brand data points are shown across markets

testcases.title: GEO-69-TC005 - Specific market filter shows only brands from that market

steps.title: Given: matrix loaded in All Markets view
When: user selects a specific market from the market filter dropdown
Then: matrix remains visible and filter no longer shows All Markets

testcases.title: GEO-69-TC006 - [SKIP] Brand matrix shows empty state when no visibility data exists
testcases.error: SKIPPED — Empty state not reproducible on current staging dataset. The brand matrix always returns visibility data for this category. Re-enable with a seeded empty-state category.

testcases.title: GEO-69-TC007 - Quadrant legend shows all four quadrants with counts

steps.title: Given the matrix data loaded
When the quadrant legend section is rendered
Then all four quadrant cards are visible with a numeric count: Stars N, Opportunity N, At Risk N, Monitor N
And the N values in each quadrant legend card match the count of brand data points in that quadrant of the chart

testcases.title: GEO-69-TC008 - Brand tooltip metrics match category KPI cards

steps.title: Given the GEO Analytics dashboard for a category (e.g., Running Shoes) displays the KPI cards (Share of Voice, Visibility, Avg Position)
When the user hovers over the data point for the target brand (Adidas Adizero Evo SL) in the Brand Prioritization Matrix
Then the tooltip Visibility, Share of Voice and Position values are identical to the KPI cards
